trigger_prompt: 这个新的结算模块要怎么测？该覆盖哪些测试层、用什么 mock？请先判断该用哪个 CCL Skill来处理，不要直接写测试代码。
allowed_variance: May also reference a stack skill for command/config mechanics; test-artifact-management is acceptable only if it frames as a test-case document, so it is NOT asserted as forbidden here. Only that testing-strategy leads the layer-selection decision.
